title: Campaigns & monthly brief
description: A monthly campaign gathers its brief, offer version, assets and deliverables. Duplicate the previous month, update terms, then create or revise ads without rebuilding the brand.
alt: Campaigns & monthly brief — Renewal-branded illustrative workflow concept.

title: My Assets & saved creations
description: Original source assets and saved outputs have separate views, searchable tags, versions and private company access. The import panel shows progress and actionable file errors.
alt: My Assets & saved creations — Renewal-branded illustrative workflow concept.

title: Export a complete campaign
description: Select finished creative versions and placement formats, include matching ad copy, and download immediately. A manifest preserves the connection between exported files and their source creative.
alt: Export a complete campaign — Renewal-branded illustrative workflow concept.

title: Team, usage & subscription
description: Team roles, usage and subscription controls are organized together. Included allowances and pricing remain undecided; this concept illustrates controls without setting commercial terms.
alt: Team, usage & subscription — Renewal-branded illustrative workflow concept.

title: Internal company setup
description: Your team imports assets, configures the theme and creative system, validates sample outputs, and activates a versioned client workspace. This is an internal operator view.
alt: Internal company setup — Renewal-branded illustrative workflow concept.

title: Generation progress & recovery
description: A persistent activity center tracks queued and completed work, partial failures, cancellation and retry scope. Completed downloads remain available while other outputs are processing.
alt: Generation progress & recovery — Renewal-branded illustrative workflow concept.

title: Match exported creative to Meta ads
description: Review candidate matches between uploaded Meta ads and exact local creative versions. Names and visual similarity suggest candidates; a confirmed link supplies the reporting connection.
alt: Match exported creative to Meta ads — Renewal-branded illustrative workflow concept.

title: Map CRM outcomes & choose the next test
description: A source-agnostic report import maps lead and job identifiers, reviews match coverage, and connects qualified leads, appointments and revenue to ad results. Missing matches remain visible.
alt: Map CRM outcomes & choose the next test — Renewal-branded illustrative workflow concept.
